headline: Small SE leftovers — dawn glass, then onshore junk.
today: A little SE swell in the water but nothing much, topping out knee-to-waist. Dawn is your only clean shot with light NW before the SE cross-on fills in around mid-morning, and the 15-plus onshore trashes it by afternoon. Fish or log on the low-to-incoming, then go get coffee.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day close to home — short-period SSE to 4.3ft, but NE cross-off keeps morning into afternoon surprisingly clean. Shortboard or fish, ride the drop-in tide.
Prime ESE angle with offshore N dawn and morning — small at waist-high but clean and peeling. Groveler dawn patrol.
